message: only module `Chan` can read field `slot` of `Chan`
label: read outside its module
notes: a word struct is sealed: what its word means is its module's business, and code that read it could hand the same word to something else (docs/memory-model.md MM-VAL-10a)
help: use the functions module `Chan` provides: a word struct's field stays in its module, `pub` or not
